primary: Center-equal clean/mixed lifecycle MSE; equally average all seeds and 24 stages inside each center/stream.
risk: Per stream harmful committed stages / all stage opportunities, downside mean over all opportunities, with all centers equally weighted by complete balanced matrix.
active: At least one clean/mixed deployed commit across full calibrated population.
selection: Among qualified active candidates min balanced MSE, then lower actual matched maintenance cost, smaller lambda, larger margin, final lexicographic ID.
baseline_no_eligible_active: Choose min MSE qualified inactive grid arm if any, otherwise min MSE grid arm marked unqualified and descriptive only. Such arms can never be the best qualified active comparator.
cost: Matched actual per-stage maintenance path including training, verification, model snapshot/cache, seal, and existing v0.2 past feedback where applicable. Postseal Service and independent audit separate.
large_CAS: Over 256MiB summed stage CAS may be external only with path+size+SHA256 index; never delete local weights.
